subway.title: Taking the Subway
subway.subtitle: Buy a ticket and get through the gates.
subway.culture: Chinese subways are clean, cheap and safe, usually 2-7 yuan per ride. You must go through security screening (安检) before entering, and many stations accept phone QR payment directly.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: 你好，我要去火车站，买一张票。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐhǎo, wǒ yào qù huǒchēzhàn, mǎi yī zhāng piào.
dialogue.en: Hello, I need to go to the train station and buy a ticket.

words.en: to want / to need / to request
a piece / a sheet / a card

dialogue.speaker: staff
dialogue.text: 四元。要充值卡还是单程票？
dialogue.pinyin: Sì yuán. Yào chōngzhí kǎ háishì dānchéng piào?
dialogue.en: Four yuan. Do you want a rechargeable card or a one-way ticket?

words.en: to want / to need / to request

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.pinyin: Dānchéng piào, xièxiè.
dialogue.en: A one-way ticket, please.

dialogue.speaker: staff
dialogue.pinyin: Shuā piào jìnzhàn, wǎng zuǒ zǒu.
dialogue.en: Swipe your ticket to enter the station and go left.

choices.en: How do I transfer to Line 1?
What time is the last train?
Is there a restroom at this station?

taxi.title: Taking a Taxi
taxi.subtitle: Give your destination and use the meter.
taxi.culture: Taxis in China run on meters (打表); insist on the meter for a fair fare. Drivers may expect the destination in Chinese, so showing the address on your phone helps. Ask for a receipt (发票) if you leave something behind.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, qù zhègè dìzhǐ.
dialogue.en: Hello, take me to this address.

dialogue.speaker: driver
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, jì hǎo ānquándài.
dialogue.en: Okay, fasten your seatbelt.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.pinyin: Dàgài yào duōjiǔ?
dialogue.en: How long will it take?

words.en: to want / to need / to request

dialogue.speaker: driver
dialogue.pinyin: Bù dǔchē dehuà èrshí fēnzhōng.
dialogue.en: About twenty minutes if there's no traffic.

choices.en: Please turn on the meter.
Stop here, please.
Can I get a receipt, please?

bus.title: City Bus
bus.subtitle: Board, pay, and watch for your stop.
bus.culture: City buses are cheap (1-2 yuan) but slow and crowded at rush hour. You pay when boarding by card or phone QR. Announcements are in Mandarin, so watch the stop names on the screen or your map.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: 你好，这路车去市中心吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, zhè lù chē qù shìzhōngxīn ma?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, does this bus go to the city center?

dialogue.speaker: driver
dialogue.pinyin: Qù de, shàng chē shuākǎ huò sǎo mǎ.
dialogue.en: Yes, you can get on and swipe your card or scan the QR code.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: 好的，到了叫我一声可以吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, dàole jiào wǒ yìshēng kěyǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Okay, can you let me know when we arrive?

dialogue.speaker: driver
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ huì tíxǐng nǐ.
dialogue.en: Sure, I'll remind you.

choices.en: How much is the fare?
Where is the next stop?

choices.pinyin: Wǒ zuò fǎn fāngxiàng le ma?
choices.en: Did I take the wrong direction?

high-speed-rail.title: High-Speed Rail
high-speed-rail.subtitle: Buy your ticket and board on time.
high-speed-rail.culture: High-speed rail (高铁) stations require your ID or passport and security checks. Arrive 30-40 minutes early — gates close a few minutes before departure. Tickets are sold at the station or on the 12306 app.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: 你好，我要买一张去上海的高铁票。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yào mǎi yī zhāng qù Shànghǎi de gāotiěpiào.
dialogue.en: Hello, I would like to buy a high-speed train ticket to Shanghai.

words.en: to want / to need / to request
a piece / a sheet / a card

dialogue.speaker: clerk
dialogue.text: 几点的？有九点和十一点的。
dialogue.pinyin: Jǐ diǎn de? yǒu jiǔ diǎn hé shíyī diǎn de.
dialogue.en: What time? We have 9:00 and 11:00.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.pinyin: Jiǔ diǎn de, èr děngzuò.
dialogue.en: The 9:00 one, second class.

dialogue.speaker: clerk
dialogue.text: 一百零八元，带好身份证。
dialogue.pinyin: Yībǎi líng bā yuán, dài hǎo shēnfènzhèng.
dialogue.en: 108 yuan. Don't forget your ID.

words.en: to bring / to have with you

choices.pinyin: Kěyǐ xuǎn kào chuāng de wèizhì ma?
choices.en: Can I choose a window seat?
How long is the journey?
Where can I change the ticket?

flight-checkin.title: Airport Check-in
flight-checkin.subtitle: Drop your bags and get your boarding pass.
flight-checkin.culture: At Chinese airports arrive at least 2 hours early for international flights. You'll pass security and a final check before boarding. Liquids over 100 ml must be checked in.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: 你好，我办值机，这是我的护照。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ bàn zhíjī, zhè shì wǒde hùzhào.
dialogue.en: Hello, I am checking in. This is my passport.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu xínglǐ yào tuōyùn ma?
dialogue.en: Do you have any luggage to check?

words.en: to want / to need / to request

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu yī jiàn, tuōyùn dào Shànghǎi.
dialogue.en: I have one piece, to be checked to Shanghai.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: 好的，这是登机牌，安检在那边。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, zhè shì dēngjīpái, ānjiǎn zài nàbiān.
dialogue.en: Okay, here's your boarding pass. Security check is over there.

choices.pinyin: Kěyǐ xuǎn kàochuāng de zuòwèi ma?
choices.en: Can I choose a window seat?
What's the baggage weight limit?
Where is the boarding gate?

ride-hailing.title: Ride-hailing (Didi)
ride-hailing.subtitle: Meet your driver and check the plate.
ride-hailing.culture: Didi (滴滴) is the main ride-hailing app in China. Always confirm the license plate and the driver's name before getting in. You pay through the app, so cash is not needed.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.pinyin: Wèi, wǒ zài T2 chūkǒu, nǐ zài nǎlǐ?
dialogue.en: Hey, I'm at exit T2. Where are you?

dialogue.speaker: driver
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ zài lùbiān, chēpái shì Jīng A12345.
dialogue.en: I'm by the roadside. My license plate is Jing A12345.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ kàndào nǐ le.
dialogue.en: Okay, I see you.

dialogue.speaker: driver
dialogue.pinyin: Shì qù jiǔdiàn duìba?
dialogue.en: We're going to the hotel, right?

choices.en: No, I'll send you the address.

choices.pinyin: Nǐ néng zài děng wǒ liǎng fēnzhōng ma?
choices.en: Can you wait for me for two more minutes?

choices.pinyin: Wǒ shàngcuò chē le zěnme bàn?
choices.en: What if I get on the wrong vehicle?

bike-share.title: Shared Bike
bike-share.subtitle: Scan the QR code and start riding.
bike-share.culture: Shared bikes (like HelloBike and Meituan) are everywhere in Chinese cities. Unlock by scanning the QR code in the app and park in designated bike zones — parking in forbidden areas incurs a fee. You need a Chinese payment method.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐhǎo, zhège dānchē zěnme yòng?
dialogue.en: Hello, how do I use this bike-sharing bike?

dialogue.speaker: staff
dialogue.text: 用手机扫车上的二维码。
dialogue.pinyin: Yòng shǒujī sǎo chē shàng de èrwéimǎ.
dialogue.en: Scan the QR code on the car with your phone.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, kěshì sǎo bù kāi.
dialogue.en: Okay, but it won't scan.

dialogue.speaker: staff
dialogue.pinyin: Shìshi chóngxīn sǎo yī cì.
dialogue.en: Try scanning again.

choices.en: How much is it for half an hour?

choices.pinyin: Tíng zài nǎlǐ dōu kěyǐ ma?
choices.en: Can I park it anywhere?
How do I return the car?

transfer-ask.title: Asking About a Transfer
transfer-ask.subtitle: Switch subway lines without leaving the station.
transfer-ask.culture: On big Chinese subway networks you switch lines at interchange stations without leaving the paid area — just follow the 换乘 signs. One ticket covers the whole trip, and there is no extra fare for transfers.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: 你好，去人民广场要换乘吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, qù rénmínguǎngchǎng yào huànchéng ma?
dialogue.en: Hello, do I need to transfer to get to People's Square?

words.en: to want / to need / to request

dialogue.speaker: staff
dialogue.text: 要的，在换乘站换二号线。
dialogue.pinyin: Yào de, zài huànchéngzhàn huàn èr hàoxiàn.
dialogue.en: Yes, transfer at the transfer station to Line 2.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.pinyin: Huànchéng yào zǒu duō yuǎn?
dialogue.en: How far is the transfer?

words.en: to want / to need / to request

dialogue.speaker: staff
dialogue.pinyin: Gēnzhe zhǐshìpái zǒu, wǔ fēnzhōng.
dialogue.en: Follow the signs; it's five minutes.

choices.en: What time is the last train/bus?
Do I need to buy another ticket?
Which line is faster?

long-distance-bus.title: Long-Distance Coach
long-distance-bus.subtitle: Buy a bus ticket to another city.
long-distance-bus.culture: Long-distance coaches (大巴) are cheaper than trains but slower. Bus stations are often near railway stations. Arrive early and keep your ticket — you may need it to board.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: 你好，我要买一张去杭州的大巴票。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yào mǎi yī zhāng qù Hángzhōu de dàbā piào.
dialogue.en: Hello, I would like to buy a bus ticket to Hangzhou.

words.en: to want / to need / to request
a piece / a sheet / a card

dialogue.speaker: clerk
dialogue.text: 几点发车？最早一班八点。
dialogue.pinyin: Jǐ diǎn fā chē? zuì zǎo yī bān bā diǎn.
dialogue.en: What time does it depart? The earliest one is at 8:00.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.pinyin: Bā diǎn de, yī zhāng.
dialogue.en: One for the 8:00 one.

words.en: a piece / a sheet / a card

dialogue.speaker: clerk
dialogue.text: 七十二元，提前十分钟进站。
dialogue.pinyin: Qīshí'èr yuán, tíqián shí fēnzhōng jìn zhàn.
dialogue.en: 72 yuan, and you need to arrive at the station 10 minutes early.

choices.en: How long is the journey?
How many stops does it make along the way?
Can it be refunded?

airport-bus.title: Airport Bus
airport-bus.subtitle: Ride the airport shuttle to downtown.
airport-bus.culture: Airport buses (机场大巴) connect city centers to airports and are cheaper than taxis, though slower. They run on a fixed schedule, so check the last bus time if your flight leaves at night.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: 你好，机场大巴多久一班？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, jīchǎng dàbā duō jiǔ yī bān?
dialogue.en: Hello, how often does the airport bus run?

dialogue.speaker: staff
dialogue.text: 每半小时一班，票价二十元。
dialogue.pinyin: Měi bàn xiǎoshí yī bān, piàojià èrshí yuán.
dialogue.en: It runs every half hour, and the fare is 20 yuan.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.pinyin: Zài nǎlǐ shàng chē?
dialogue.en: Where do I board?

dialogue.speaker: staff
dialogue.pinyin: Jiù zài ménkǒu, kàn zhǐshì pái.
dialogue.en: It's right at the door, just look at the signs.

words.en: to look / to watch / to read

choices.en: How long does it take to get to the airport?

words.en: to want / to need / to request

choices.en: Can I pay by phone?
What time is the last train/bus?
